work_completed: Owner's order (25/11): no separate 'Lunet Nova'; Lunet is one app. io.lunet.studio now opens on the Avalonia shell (ShellActivity, an AvaloniaActivity that starts Avalonia on demand — Avalonia's AvaloniaAndroidApplication would start it in the :gameplay/:preview processes too, per its source).

Same games and key: the shell resolves the projects folder exactly like MainActivity (Files/Projects or the shared working copy in settings.json); the APK keeps package and signing, so it updates the installed app.

Nothing disappears: screens not yet moved open by route over the same game (MainActivity.Route): Home destinations and the game's 'Mais' panel; Back saves and returns; the shell reloads documents changed there without overwriting unsaved edits.
Removed Lunet.Shell.Android and the second APK from the release; emulator stage now installs and drives io.lunet.studio.
